title: FinCube DAO-Proposal-Governance with DORI: multi-source blockchain event observation and reconciliation
description:
Source code of the FinCube DAO-Proposal-Governance system (frontend, microservices, smart contracts) used to evaluate DORI.

Version 2.0.0 adds the DORI module behind the DORI_ENABLED flag: deterministic EventKey derivation, multi-source observation with quorum-based reconciliation and canonical lookup, revision records, a dedicated exchange, and consumer-side receipt records keyed by (EventKey, version). Existing flows are unchanged when the flag is off. Version 1 remains available as an earlier version of this record.
